skills.name: # key-guard  A local MCP server that keeps API keys off Claude's servers.  ## Why This Exists  When Claude reads a file containing an API key, the raw key content gets sent to Claude's servers. key-guard prevents this by acting as a local middleman — Claude calls a tool, the tool reads the key and makes the API call locally, and only the result is returned to Claude.
